what_it_does: Designs a power amplifier (electronic signal booster) for millimeter-wave phased array antenna systems. The challenge is that when multiple antennas are packed close together in an array, they interfere with each other, causing impedance (electrical resistance) to vary unpredictably across frequency and scanning angle. This paper proposes a compact amplifier using an LC-neutralization topology (a circuit technique using inductors and capacitors) that maintains stable output power and efficiency even under this variable impedance stress.
